reason: Former German international (2014 World Cup winner, retired 2025) with a documented career at Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund and AS Roma. Recent news: a two-year Bentley ambassador role focused on German-speaking markets. The 31 Oct 2026 TV appearance could not be verified from any source and is excluded.
